title: AIEval360 Dataset Record Schema
description: Schema for all CSV-based evaluation datasets in AIEval360. All records must conform to this schema before evaluation.

record_id.description: Unique record identifier. Format: <SECTOR_PREFIX>_<NNN> e.g. BNK_001, UNI_005, INS_012

question.description: The question posed to the AI model. Must be non-empty.

context.description: Retrieved context provided to the model (simulates RAG retrieval). May be the full policy text, PDS excerpt, or regulatory passage.

ground_truth_answer.description: The correct answer according to policy, regulation, or expert review.

model_answer.description: The AI model's response. May be intentionally incorrect for evaluation testing.

sector.description: Industry sector for threshold and regulatory alignment.

use_case.description: Specific use case within the sector. Used for reporting and risk classification.

risk_level.description: Governance risk classification. CRITICAL records require mandatory human review on failure.

notes.description: Optional notes on record intent (e.g. 'INTENTIONAL_ERROR — tests hallucination detection').
